page.title: Notification routing
page.description: Which alerts leave the site, and where the webhooks go. Times are UTC.

forbidden.heading: Notification routing cannot be shown to this account.
forbidden.body: Reading and changing it needs the <perm>admin:notifications</perm> permission. The read-only role does not include it. Nothing was changed.

error.advice: Nothing was changed. Check that the backend is reachable, then try again.

rules.heading: Routing rules ({count} of {max})
rules.empty: No routing rules. Alerts still use the .env channels and e-mail recipients.
rules.intro: A rule adds destinations for the alerts it matches. Every matching rule applies. The .env channels and e-mail recipients keep working unless a matching rule stops them.
rules.limit: This site already has the maximum of {max} rules. Remove one to add another.
rules.needDestination: Add a destination first: a rule needs at least one.
rules.destinationsLoading: Loading the destinations. A rule needs at least one.
rules.destinationsFailed: The destinations could not be loaded, so a rule cannot be added. Nothing was changed.
rules.deleteBody: Alerts it matched stop going to its destinations. Notifications already sent are not affected.

form.name: Name
form.priorityHint: Lower numbers are listed first. Every matching rule applies, whatever its priority.
form.severityHint: The rule matches this severity and every higher one. Info alerts are not routed.
form.ownersHint: Separate with commas. Empty means any owner.
form.classesHint: Separate with commas, for example WAF, IPS. Empty means any class.
form.groupsHint: Separate with commas. Empty means any group.
form.groupsInvalid: Group ids are whole numbers separated by commas.
form.windowHint: Enter 24-hour times such as 22:00. The window uses the time the alert changed state, in UTC.
form.windowWrap: This window runs past midnight: from {start} UTC to 24:00, and on to {end} UTC the next day.
form.windowInvalid: Enter both times as HH:MM between 00:00 and 23:59. They must differ.
form.destinationsMax: A rule can name at most {max} destinations.
form.stopDefault: Stop the .env channels and e-mail recipients for the alerts this rule matches
form.stopDefaultWarn: The matched alerts reach only the destinations picked here. Turn this on only when those destinations replace e-mail and the .env channels.

destinations.heading: Webhook destinations ({count} of {max})
destinations.empty: No webhook destinations. Alerts still use the .env channels and e-mail recipients.
destinations.intro: Each destination receives the versioned JSON webhook. Its URL, signing secret and header values are stored encrypted and are never shown again.
destinations.limit: This site already has the maximum of {max} destinations. Remove one to add another.
destinations.deleteBody: Its stored URL, secret and headers are discarded. A destination that a rule uses cannot be deleted.

outcome.notSent: The test of {name} was not sent.

next.ok: The test event carries a test marker and does not stand for an alert.
next.transport: The connection failed before an answer. Check the address, the network path and the firewall.
next.timeout: The endpoint did not answer within 10 seconds. Check that it is running.
next.http_status: The endpoint answered with an error status. Check its log.
next.ssrf_refused: The address is private, or it uses HTTP without the flag. Tick the matching option on the destination only for an endpoint you trust.
next.redirect_refused: The endpoint answered with a redirect. Redirects are never followed. Enter the final address.
next.payload_invalid: The stored headers are not valid. Edit the destination and replace its headers.

form.name: Name
form.urlHint: Starts with https://. The path and query are stored encrypted and are not shown again.
form.urlReplaceHint: Leave empty to keep the stored URL.
form.allowHttpWarn: The webhook, including any header, is sent in clear text. Allow it only for an endpoint on a network you trust.
form.allowPrivateWarn: The destination may resolve to an internal or loopback address. Allow it only for an endpoint the site administrator trusts.
form.secretHint: When set, every webhook carries an HMAC-SHA-256 signature. The secret is never shown again.
form.headersHint: Up to five. A header value is never shown again.
form.headersReplaceHint: The headers below replace every stored header. Leave them empty to remove all.
